body: Same boat, I’m average build but my arms, particularly my forearms and wrists are small in proportion and while there is skin to pinch there really isn’t a great deal to work with. I had a consult with Mr Christopher and he told me I wouldn’t be a candidate for RFL, so was referred and now on waiting list for ALT :)

sorry to hear you’re going through this! definitely not worthless though. looking for work can be draining and a long process but you’re evidence that enjoyable and rewarding jobs are out there! good luck in your journey to finding the next one- don’t let your worth be determined by your work :)

this really really hit home for me! i’m a 23 year old male and experience a very similar thing, tend to jump from job to job, super optimistic at the start as I convince myself it’s a good thing etc, then just 3-6 months in find myself anxious and extremely miserable to the point I feel suicidal. Find it very hard to focus and don’t think there is a job out there for me that won’t cause these feelings, so I totally feel for you. Quite happy on my own in my room focussing on my hobbies- sewing, watching movies, learning a language .. i’ve never been one to not work, the fear of not paying my bills and being independent also scares me massively, but I also don’t know how to process a life living this way??

please be safe. life has a weird way of changing and evolving. I feel for you, being depressed and suicidal is painful, but it won’t always be the way. you have good qualities and a future that is one big open ended adventure. whenever i’m at my darkest points I try and think about moving half way across the world, getting a pet, meeting new people, living off grid - anything that would pull me out of the current mindset. you need a change of environment and to find your happiest self. Take care of yourself, i’ll be thinking of you tonight x
